findings.passage: A voter registration system at the DMV must never serve as a backdoor for ineligible registrations.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name on the auditor general's audit of the automatic voter registration system at the driver licensing agency; says the system lacks a mandatory validated citizenship flag.

findings.passage: The goal was simple: determine whether non-citizens were being inadvertently registered to vote and restore public confidence that our election system protects the votes of qualified electors.
findings.note: Describes why she asked in August 2024 for a comparison of driver-licensing records of non-citizens against the voter registry.

findings.passage: “As I examined the control concerns in the Auditor General’s Audit of the Statewide Uniform Registry of Electors (SURE) system completed in 2019 by then Auditor General, Eugene DePasquale, it became apparent that certain controls were lacking in the system of internal and external controls on voting which helped create confusion in the election reporting,” Keefer wrote in a memorandum describing her measure.
findings.note: Quoted by the Star News Network from her co-sponsorship memo for a bill requiring periodic audits of the voter registry.
